author: OpenCode
name: cog-lastfm-summary
description: A Red-DiscordBot cog that links Last.fm accounts and posts a periodic top artists or albums grid image for every linked member.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Last.fm Summary! Set a Last.fm API key with `[p]lastfmset api_key` as the bot owner, configure a channel and period, then have members run `[p]lastfm register <username>`.
